runtimeFlags: Windows 11, SYCL F16 JIT backend, oneAPI 2026.1.1, -ngl 99 -fa 1, split-mode layer, -ts 1.25/0.75, -b 4096 -ub 4096, KV q8_0, native draft-mtp (n_max 3)
notes: Windows 11 Pro. Measured on 2x Intel Arc Pro B60 24GB (Maxsun Dual 48G Turbo). Custom JIT SYCL build with GGML_SYCL_F16=ON, GGML_SYCL_DNN=ON, Level-Zero. Model: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B (Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_L.gguf, 17.72 GiB) with embedded Q8_0 MTP draft head. decodeTps is 24.00 t/s with native MTP speculative decoding (--spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-device SYCL0 --spec-draft-n-max 3; 20-30 t/s across context lengths in chat). Stock non-MTP decode is 16.13 t/s. promptTps is 609.47 t/s at pp512 (ttftMs: 840.1 ms; scaling to 925.39 t/s at 4k, 825.18 t/s at 32k, 724.73 t/s at 64k, and 570.24 t/s at 128k with Q8_0 KV).
